justification: Adds null guard scanner to qa_gate.py, post-commit hash stamping hook, and insert script test suite. Changes validation rules gating all future pushes.

pre_impl.existing_data: qa_gate.py has DB guard scanner, AST grounding, tier floor, commit hash binding, break-it repro. Adding null guard scanner on top.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Null guard scanner checks .rows[0] access patterns. Could false-positive on non-DB .rows arrays (e.g. CSV parsing). Mitigated by only scanning .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx files.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New checks apply to all future pushes. Post-commit hook patches existing .qa_report.json files. Tests validate existing insert scripts retroactively.

functions.name: scan_diff_for_unguarded_nulls
functions.input: diff_files list of relative paths, project_dir string for resolving full paths
functions.output: list of error strings for each unguarded .rows[0] access found in TS/JS files
functions.if_none: empty diff_files or missing project_dir returns empty list (no false failures)

functions.name: _load_rows
functions.output: list of dicts from module-level variable, loaded without executing main()
functions.if_none: Returns empty list if module or variable not found

values.if_missing: Scanner would find no .rows[0] accesses, all pass silently
All .rows[0] accesses flagged as unguarded (false positives)

values.nullable: no — hardcoded set of 28 LGA slugs
values.if_missing: LGA validation tests would have no reference set

queries: N/A — no database queries in this change

break_it.scenario: TS file uses .rows[0] for a non-DB array (e.g. CSV rows)
break_it.what_happens: False positive — scanner flags a safe access as unguarded
break_it.how: scripts/qa_gate.py:352 — only scans .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx files; non-DB .rows arrays are rare in frontend code and can be suppressed with .rows[0]?. pattern
break_it.repro: Create a .ts file with 'const x = csvRows.rows[0].col' and run scan_diff_for_unguarded_nulls(['test.ts'], '.')

break_it.scenario: Post-commit hook enters infinite loop (amend triggers post-commit again)
break_it.what_happens: Git hangs on commit in an infinite amend loop
break_it.how: .githooks/post-commit:24 — uses POST_COMMIT_HASH_LOCK file; if lock exists, hook exits immediately and removes lock
break_it.repro: git commit with .qa_report.json containing commit_hash field — should amend once and stop

break_it.scenario: Insert script adds a new LGA not in ALL_LGAS test constant
break_it.what_happens: test_lga_values_valid fails — alerts developer to update test set
break_it.how: tests/test_insert_scripts.py:40 — ALL_LGAS must be updated when new councils are onboarded. Test failure is the desired behavior.
break_it.repro: Add a row with lga='new_council' to POS_ROWS, run pytest tests/test_insert_scripts.py -v
